google.unavailable: Google sign-in isn't available right now

panel.loginText: VocaSpace uses FSRS to work out when you're about to forget each card and schedules your review right before that. Review less often and remember longer.
panel.forgotText: Without review, any memory fades. One review lifts it back up.
panel.forgotSentText: Open the email, follow the link and set a new password to keep learning.
panel.register1Text: Your curve starts today. With every step you finish, it gets a little stronger.
panel.register2Text: Every time you review on schedule, the gap before your next review grows.
panel.register3Text: A profile photo is optional. You can skip it and add one later.
panel.register4Text: Open your email and follow the link to continue to setting your password.
panel.settledText: Set your password and you can sign in with your email and keep learning.

login.title: Welcome back
login.lead: Sign in to pick up right where you left off.

authError.confirm: This verification link is invalid or has expired
authError.recovery: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. You can request a new one.
authError.oauth: Google sign-in didn't work. You can try again or sign in with email.

login.networkFailed: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: Enter your VocaSpace account email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.

register.lead1: It takes about a minute. You'll set your password after you verify your email.
register.emailHint: We'll send the verification link to this email.
register.lead3: Optional. You can add or change it later in your profile.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.sentTo: We've sent a verification link to
checkEmail.lead: Follow the link in the email to verify, then set your password in the last step.
checkEmail.resendFailed: Couldn't resend the email. Please try again later.
checkEmail.spamNote: Can't find the email? Check your Spam folder or resend it in a few minutes.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.lead: Your email is verified. Set a password so you can sign in with your email from now on.

curve.label: Illustration of how VocaSpace schedules your reviews
curve.heading: Memory curve
curve.summaryLogin: Illustration: each review made just before you forget lifts your memory back near 100%, and the gaps between reviews grow; without review, memory fades.
curve.summaryRegister: Illustration: the memory curve gains one more review after each sign-up step.
curve.summarySettled: Illustration: after many well-timed reviews, memory stays steady near 100%.
curve.summaryForgot: Illustration: without review, memory fades; one review brings it back to 100%.
curve.peekText: The card turns away while you type your password.

deck.label: Illustration of how VocaSpace reviews your cards
deck.peekText: The card turns face down while you type your password.
deck.loginText: Due cards come back to the top of the stack for review. VocaSpace uses FSRS to pick that moment.
deck.forgotSentText: Open the link in the email to set a new password, like a review bringing the card back into focus.
deck.forgotText: Without review, the card fades. A reset link will bring you back.
deck.verifyTitle: One more step: verify your email.
deck.verifyText: The “verify” card is waiting for you to open your email. After verifying, you'll set your password to finish.
deck.stageTitle: Each step adds a card to the stack.
deck.stageText: Step {stage}/5 adds the “{word}” card. With 5 cards, your account is ready.
deck.settledTitle: The last card: secure your account.
deck.settledText: Set your password to complete your stack.

actions.signUpRetry: Sign-up didn't go through. Please try again.
actions.usernameTaken: That username is already taken. Try another one.
actions.resend: A new verification email will arrive in a few minutes. Check your Spam folder too!
actions.recovery: Request sent! Check your inbox (and Spam folder) in a few minutes.
actions.setPasswordNotAllowed: This verification session can no longer be used to set a password. Please sign in again.
actions.setPasswordFailed: Couldn't set your password. Please try again.
actions.setPasswordSessionExpired: This verification session is over 24 hours old. Request a new link on the Forgot password page.
actions.samePassword: Your new password must be different from your old one.
actions.weakPassword: This password is too weak or easy to guess. Choose a different one.
